development.//: No `env` block on purpose: a dev-client build must keep reading the developer's local mobile/.env so day-to-day work is unchanged. app.config.ts still refuses APP_ENV=production with a non-production DATA_MODE.

preview.//: Internal/tester builds. DATA_MODE must never be `mock` here — testers would exercise seeded fake patient data and the QA pass would be worthless. The remaining EXPO_PUBLIC_* values (API_URL, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) are environment-specific and are supplied by EAS environment variables, NOT committed here; env.ts throws if any is missing while DATA_MODE is not `mock`.

production.//: Store builds. APP_ENV=production also disables the app/dev/* routes (see isDev in src/config/env.ts). API_URL / SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY come from EAS environment variables.
